# SillyMedia Solutions — Complete Reference Context

> Note: Support for llms-full.txt by AI crawlers is voluntary and not guaranteed. All facts below match the pre-rendered HTML pages published on https://sillymedia.in.

## 1. Organization Overview
SillyMedia Solutions is an independent Delhi NCR digital engineering agency founded and operated directly by Naveen. Clients collaborate directly with the founder on custom websites, hyperlocal SEO & Google Maps optimization, official WhatsApp Business Cloud API automation, full-stack web apps & SaaS MVPs, and grounded AI chatbots.

- Canonical Website: https://sillymedia.in
- Direct Email: naveen@sillymedia.in
- Service Area: Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad (National Capital Region, India)
- Delivery Philosophy: Fixed milestone quotes, full client code/domain ownership, pre-rendered HTML for crawlability and mobile Core Web Vitals, and zero guaranteed "#1 ranking" gimmicks.

## 2. Services & Typical Timelines
1. **Custom Website Development** (`/services/custom-websites`)
   - Pre-rendered Next.js static/SSR architecture, mobile-first design, local SEO metadata & JSON-LD, click-to-call/WhatsApp triggers, UTM-tracked inquiry form.
   - Typical timeline: 14–21 working days.
2. **Hyperlocal SEO & Google Maps** (`/services/local-seo-google-maps`)
   - Google Business Profile audit & category alignment, neighbourhood landing pages, LocalBusiness schema, ethical customer review workflows, call/inquiry reporting.
   - Initial audit in 7 days; competitive Map Pack movement varies by locality density (typically 3–6 months in dense hubs like South Delhi or Cyber Hub).
3. **WhatsApp Business Automation** (`/services/whatsapp-automation`)
   - Official Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API setup, automated inquiry qualification, clinic appointment confirmations & reminders, CRM/Sheets sync, instant human escalation.
   - Typical timeline: 2–3 weeks.
4. **Full-Stack Web Apps & SaaS MVPs** (`/services/web-apps-saas`)
   - TypeScript, Next.js App Router, PostgreSQL, multi-tenant role-based auth, Razorpay/Stripe/UPI integrations, operational dashboards, GST/audit exports.
   - Typical timeline: 4–6 weeks for MVP scope.
5. **Custom AI Chatbots & Workflow Agents** (`/services/ai-chatbots-agents`)
   - Knowledge-base grounded (RAG) assistants supporting English, Hindi, and Hinglish with strict guardrails, human fallback, and transparent API billing.
   - Typical timeline: 2–4 weeks.
